notes.title: Patch 1.3.0
notes.content:
added features:
- unit rage system

changed features:
- animations are now available when receiving items

rage system:
the rage system is a comeback mechanism. the higher the rage, the higher the damage / healing caused.
in the case of non-critical attacks, the unit gets -2% rage.
in the case of critical attacks, the unit gets -4% rage.
when suffering from non-critical attacks, the unit gets 4% rage.
when suffering from critical attacks, the unit gets 8% rage.
in the case of non-critical caused healing, the unit gets -1% rage.
in the case of a critical healing, the unit gets -2% rage.
when receiving non-critical healing, the unit gets -1% rage.
when receiving critical healing, the unit gets -2% rage.
if a team member dies, the rest of the team gets 8% rage.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.3
notes.content:
balancing:
- "lifesteal" talent now heals you for 40% of your damage done (was 20%)
- "protecting shield" talent now gives you 40 hp (was 30)
- "thornmail" talent now deals 20% damage back (was 10%)

added features:
- live progress of unit quests are now displayed during a game

changed features:
- some design changes

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.content:
bugfixes:
- die animations of units should now work
- counter attack talent should now trigger the attack animation

added features:
- there is now feedback for talent triggers in form of combat text

changed features:
- floor colors are now more transparent
- some design changes

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.content:
bugfixes:
- "fullscreen" and "fullscreen (borderless)" were swapped in the graphics settings
- some keybindings did not work and have now been corrected

added features:
- a message about the start of a game phase has been added

changed features:
- irrelevant values are now hidden in the item tooltip
- animations in turn phase have been optimized

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
added features:
- resolution config in settings view
- window mode config in settings view
- equip icon on empty item slots in unit view
- close button in gamesettings view
- "attack all" and "attack/heal all" buttons have now been added to automate repetitive actions

changed features:
- colored text for rarity in shop view
- shape of fire particles has been changed and the brightness has been reduced
- movement, attack and healing animation speed has been increased
- waiting time between animations from different units has been removed
- nameplates of units have changed in 3 different colors:
> blue for units that you own and can do actions
> green for units that you own and can not do actions
> red for units that you dont own

balancing:
- all units have 50hp less

notes.title: Release 1.0.0
notes.content:
features:
- 8 playable characters (5 unlocked, 3 buyable with blue essences)
- 18 quests
- 40 items (8 item sets, 4 different tiers)
- items can be dismantled to red essences
- 9 talents
- unit statistics view
- 4 game modes: 1 pve, 3 pvp (vs ai, normal pvp, ranked pvp, custom game vs your friends)
- pve + pvp ladder
- 3 buyable chests (with red essences)
- 2 buyable boosts (with red essences)
- basic settings (audio, graphics, display, keybindings)
- lobby + game chat
- emojis
